health.description: Health solutions are vital elixirs that swiftly restore the user's vitality, mending wounds and rejuvenating the body to ensure peak combat performance in the midst of adversity.

items.name: Regeneration Solution
properties: Restores 3 Health every start of your Turn until combat ends

focus.description: Focus solutions enhance mental acuity and concentration, providing users with heightened awareness and cognitive sharpness during critical moments in combat.

items.name: Rejuvenation Solution
properties: Restores 1 Focus every start of your Turn until combat ends

reflex.description: Reflex solutions grant users heightened agility and swiftness, allowing for quick and precise movements that are crucial in out-of-turn actions and outmaneuvering adversaries.

items.name: Energizing Solution
properties: Restores 1 Reflex every start of your Turn until combat ends

remedies.description: Remedies are versatile solutions that offer solutions to a variety of ailments and conditions, providing users with the means to overcome and adapt to the challenges presented in combat.

items.name: Lesser Remedy
properties: Removes mild negative conditions (Bleed, Crippled, Dazed, Distracted, Exposed, Flinched, Hindered, Impaired, Slowed) instantly

items.name: Greater Remedy
properties: Removes mild to moderate negative conditions (Blinded, Burned, Chilled, Deafened, Disabled, Fatigued, Immobilized, Poisoned, Sapped, Silenced, Vulnerable, Weakened) instantly

items.name: All Remedy
properties: Removes Mild to Severe Conditions (Asleep, Drained, Exhausted, Restrained, Rot, Staggered) instantly

boosters.description: Boosters are potent concoctions that combine various effects, offering users a strategic advantage by providing a versatile array of benefits tailored to the demands of diverse combat scenarios.

items.name: Revival Solution
properties: Restores 10 Health instantly when your Health reaches 0

items.name: Adrenaline Solution
properties: All your Base Dice increases by 1 size until combat ends

items.name: Numb Solution
properties: Gain Resistance to Slice, Blunt, and Pierce damage until combat ends

items.name: Burn Solution
properties: Gain Immunity to Burn damage until combat ends

items.name: Frost Solution
properties: Gain Immunity to Frost damage until combat ends

items.name: Shock Solution
properties: Gain Immunity to Shock damage until combat ends

items.name: Toxic Solution
properties: Gain Immunity to Toxic damage until combat ends

items.name: Corruption Solution
properties: Gain Immunity to Corruption damage until combat ends

items.name: Stamina Solution
properties: Gain 1 extra Stamina until combat ends
